name: Pedram MohammadAliPour
summary: I'm a mobile developer with over nine years of experience building Android and Flutter apps. I started with native Android and have focused on Flutter since 2019, delivering cross-platform apps with clean architecture and solid performance. At Dotin I work on financial and ERP apps, and freelance work has sharpened how I manage time, talk with clients and ship production-ready code on my own.

labels.more: The full story, year by year:

experience.title: Flutter Software Engineer
notes: Works on the Flutter Mobile Runner, the front end of an app generation platform.
Builds and maintains core features in several mobile projects, with a focus on performance, scalability and smooth UX.

experience.title: Flutter Team Lead
notes: Led the Flutter team building a digital wallet with credit-based payments, and contributed to a supply chain finance (SCF) app.

experience.title: Flutter Developer → Team Lead
notes: Led development of HamrahShahr Plus, the mobile bank for Shahr Bank, its back office and several ERP apps.
Ran the Flutter team's process, code quality and app performance.

experience.title: Android Developer
notes: The only mobile developer, taking apps from UI design to release; moved to Flutter after two years.
